name: Housing
blurb: Plugins for decorating, placing and managing houses, apartments and your Free Company estate.

name: Roleplay and venues
blurb: Character profiles, custom titles, RP event calendars, and tools for running or visiting player venues.

name: Minigames and fun
blurb: Games to play while you wait or lie dead on the floor, plus dice, cards and other silly extras.

name: Glamour and mods
blurb: Outfit, plate and appearance tools, camera and screenshot helpers, and tools for mod loaders and posing.

name: Market and economy
blurb: Market board price checks, retainer helpers, and tools for selling and crafting for profit.

name: Crafting and gathering
blurb: Crafting macros and solvers, gathering routes and node timers, fishing helpers, and Island Sanctuary planners.

name: Combat and duties
blurb: Job gauges, cooldown trackers, mechanic helpers, fly text, and tools for dungeons, roulettes, hunts and other duty content.

name: UI and HUD
blurb: Replacements and tweaks for the HUD, hotbars, bars, windows, nameplates, tooltips and menus.

name: Chat and social
blurb: Chat windows and filters, friend lists, linkshells, translation, and tools for staying in touch.

name: Audio and music
blurb: Orchestrion, bard and music helpers, plus sound and volume controls.

name: Graphics and performance
blurb: Frame rate, resolution, shadow and render settings, crash and input fixes, and other tweaks to the game client itself.

name: Quality of life
blurb: Small helpers that remove friction: tweaks, reminders, collection trackers, notifications and shortcuts.

name: Other
blurb: Everything that does not fit a bigger bucket: odd, useful and one-of-a-kind plugins.
